headline: Arvind SmartSpaces accepts IT head retirement and names Kishor Vegada successor
hook: Leadership transition in IT at Arvind SmartSpaces
summary: Arvind SmartSpaces has announced a leadership change in its IT department following the retirement of its previous IT head. Kishor Vegada has been appointed as the new successor to lead the company's technology functions. This is a routine operational transition within the real estate developer. Indian retail investors should note this is standard management succession with no immediate financial impact.
why_it_matters: Routine leadership change with no financial impact on shareholders.
